docs.title: Accessing your GoToMyPC Virtual Machine
docs.text:
You will need the Email Address, Password, and Access Code provided by your trainer to complete these steps.

If you enter an incorrect password 3 times, the account will be locked out for 5 mins!

  • It is important that a reconnect is not attempted during this period otherwise the time out will be extended.
  • The account will always reset after that 5 min period with the same credentials.
  • Do not attempt to change the password and do not click the "forgot password" link.

docs.title: Step 1: Sign in to GoToMyPC
docs.text:
1. Open the GoToMyPC link from your setup page.

  2. Enter the Email Address and Password provided by your trainer and click Sign In.

Seeing a different screen? Sign in with the same credentials.

Some learners are taken to the main GoToMyPC login page instead. Sign in with the same credentials.

docs.title: Step 2: Enter the Access Code
docs.text: 1. When prompted, enter the Access Code provided by your trainer and click Connect.

docs.title: Step 3: Connect to your virtual machine
docs.text: You should now see a Windows desktop similar to this:

docs.title: Step 4: Customise your GoToMyPC window
docs.text:
Before you start working, change two settings in GoToMyPC to avoid interruptions during the session.

If you can't see the menu bar, then move your cursor to the top of your screen.

In the menu bar at the top of the window, click Tools then Preferences.

docs.title: Turn off Dim Viewer
docs.text: 1. On the Viewer tab, uncheck Dim Viewer when inactive.

docs.title: Increase the session timeout
docs.text:
1. In the menu bar at the top of the window, click Tools then Preferences.

  2. On the Security tab, change the Viewer Security Time-Out to more than 300 minutes.

    Click the checkbox next to the number field to enable editing, then increase the value.

You are now set up and ready to go. Let your trainer know in the chat that you are all set up with GoToMyPC.

docs.title: Accessing Learn On Demand (LOD)
docs.text: You will need a QA Learn On Demand account and an LOD key from your trainer to complete these steps.

docs.title: Step 1: Go to the QA Learn On Demand website
docs.text: 1. Open a browser and go to qa.learnondemand.net

docs.title: Step 2: Sign in to your LOD account
docs.text:
If you do not have a QA LOD account yet, you need to create one first.

  1. Click Create an Account
  2. Enter your details using your work email address
  3. Click Save

  1. Enter your Username and Password and click Sign in.

docs.title: Step 3: Check your dashboard
docs.text: You should see your Learn On Demand dashboard:

docs.title: Step 4: Redeem your LOD key
docs.text:
You will need a LOD key from your trainer to complete this step.

  1. Copy and paste your LOD key (provided by your trainer) into the Redeem Training Key box.

  2. Click Redeem.

docs.title: Step 5: Launch the virtual machine
docs.text:
A course for this week should now appear on your dashboard.

  1. Click the course for this week.

  2. Click the Launch button.

docs.title: Step 6: Wait for the lab to build
docs.text:
Your LOD lab is now being built. This may take a minute or two.

When the build is complete, you should see a Windows desktop like this:

docs.title: Step 7: Customise the virtual machine
docs.text:
The LOD interface includes an instructions pane on the right -- you can remove it to give yourself more screen space.

  1. Click the Computer icon in the top-left toolbar.

  2. Click Split Windows -- the instructions pane can now be minimised.

  3. To make the VM fill your screen, click Full Screen in the top-left toolbar, or maximise the browser window -- the VM will scale to fit.

To paste text into the VM, use the Keyboard icon in the top-left toolbar.

You are now set up with Learn on Demand. Let your trainer know in the WebEx chat that you are ready to go.
